label: Supplementary practice — 1000 MCQ Statistics Test Series (PDF page 405)

items.stem: A botanist records seedling height Y and weeks after planting X for n=6 seedlings. The summary statistics are X̄=4.67, Ȳ=9.467, ΣXᵢ²=154 and ΣXᵢYᵢ=325.9. What is the fitted least-squares regression line of Y on X?
items.explanation: The least-squares slope is b=[ΣXY−nX̄Ȳ]/[ΣX²−nX̄²]. Substituting gives b=[325.9−6(4.67)(9.467)]/[154−6(4.67²)]≈2.6196, or 2.62. The intercept is a=Ȳ−bX̄≈9.467−2.6196(4.67)≈−2.7665, or −2.8. Therefore the fitted line is Ŷ=−2.8+2.62X.
